confidence_notes: I ran two web searches. One was for the RBA rate and one was for Orlando price indexes. The RBA figure is 0.6720 USD per AUD, as of 18 November 2026. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors come from aggregated crowdsourced indexes (Expatica citing Numbeo, MyLifeElsewhere, Traveltables): an inexpensive meal about $20, a three-course meal for two $50 to $85, a cappuccino about $4.50 to $5, and a domestic draft beer about $6. The search found no cocktail or restaurant wine-by-the-glass prices. I estimated cocktail at about 2.3 times beer and wine glass at about 2.2 times beer, based on typical US restaurant price relationships. The tourist-area premium is not captured by the indexes, so I nudged the mid-range meal and the drinks up slightly. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Orlando, a high-volume tourist market. They are not from live listings. Orlando has few true hostels, so hostel and 1-star prices are especially uncertain. The 3-star price is a blended estimate across the year.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other large US leisure destinations such as Las Vegas and Miami. Orlando is somewhat cheaper than Miami for dining and lodging, with some resort-area premium.
